title: Integration Credentials
description: The vault for tool and integration secrets. Register once, reference everywhere.

placeholders.name: e.g. Dify production
placeholders.valueEdit: Leave empty to keep the current value

empty.title: No credentials registered
empty.description: Register an integration credential to reuse it across agents, bots, tools and MCPs.

installationEmpty: No default credential set at the installation level.

deleteDialog.title: Delete credential
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete the credential "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.inUseWarning: This credential is referenced by {{count}} consumer(s): {{consumers}}. They will fall back to their inline value while it exists.

messages.requiredFields: Fill in name, provider and value

permissionDenied.read: You do not have permission to view integration credentials
permissionDenied.installation: You do not have permission to manage installation credentials

inUse.title: In use in this account
inUse.empty: No consumer resolves credentials from the vault yet. External agents, bots, tools and MCPs will appear here as they adopt it.

oauthSection.noSecretHint: These connections keep no secret in the vault: the token stays in the store that owns it, and what you see here is read from there at listing time.
oauthSection.empty: No OAuth connection yet. Connect a provider from the agent's integrations screen and it will appear here.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect integration
disconnectDialog.description: Disconnect the {{provider}} connection? The agent stops using this integration.
disconnectDialog.noRevokeWarning: Disconnecting removes the access locally. It does NOT revoke the grant at the provider: to fully revoke it, use the provider's own security settings.
